title: Reasonable Security Practices & Sensitive Personal Data
description: Body corporate possessing, dealing or handling sensitive personal data or information (SPDI) in a computer resource must implement and maintain reasonable security practices and procedures under Information Technology SPI Rules 2011 Rule 8.

sub_elements.element_text: Comprehensive documented information security policy and data protection procedures
Operational and managerial security control measures including access control and data encryption
Adherence to prescribed security standard such as ISO/IEC 27001 or equivalent certified standard
Periodic independent safety and Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) audit by certified auditor

title: Punishment for Violation of Bodily Privacy & Surveillance Guard
description: Prohibits intentionally capturing, publishing, or transmitting the image of a private area of any person without consent under circumstances violating privacy. Serves as bodily privacy surveillance guard.

title: Constitution of Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)
description: Employer must constitute an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) at each administrative office with mandatory statutory composition rules.

sub_elements.element_text: Presiding Officer must be a senior level woman employee employed at the workplace
At least 2 employee members committed to the cause of women or having legal knowledge or experience
1 external member from an NGO or association committed to the cause of women or familiar with sexual harassment issues
At least 50 percent of total nominated ICC members must be women

title: Statutory Sexual Harassment Complaint Filing Window
description: Aggrieved woman must be permitted to file a written complaint of sexual harassment to the ICC within a minimum statutory window of 3 months from the date of incident.

title: Monthly Wage Payment Deadline
description: Wages payable on a monthly basis must be paid before the expiry of the 7th day of the succeeding month across all establishments.

title: Full & Final Settlement Payment Window
description: Where an employee is removed, dismissed, retrenched, resigned, or superannuated, wages due must be paid within 2 working days.

title: Maximum Permissible Wage Deduction Cap
description: Total deductions made from the wages of an employee in any wage period shall not exceed 50 percent of total wages.

title: Earned Leave Accumulation & Carry-Forward Cap (Maharashtra)
description: An employee can accumulate earned leave up to a maximum limit of 45 days in Maharashtra. Accumulated unavailed leave must be encashed upon separation.

statute_citation: Karnataka Shops & Commercial Establishments Act 1961 Section 15(2)
title: Earned Leave Accumulation & Carry-Forward Cap (Karnataka)
description: An employee can accumulate earned leave up to a maximum limit of 30 days in Karnataka. Unavailed leave in excess of 30 days shall lapse or be encashed.

title: Personal Data Breach Notification Requirement
description: In the event of a personal data breach, data fiduciary must give the Board and each affected Data Principal intimation of such breach without unreasonable delay.

title: Agreement in Restraint of Trade Void
description: Every agreement by which any one is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of any kind is to that extent void. Silence in policy text is informational/permissive, not non-compliant.

title: Mandatory Paid Maternity Leave Duration
description: Maximum period for which any woman shall be entitled to maternity benefit shall be 26 weeks of paid leave.

title: Mandatory Crèche Facility Provision
description: Every establishment having 50 or more employees shall have the facility of a crèche within prescribed distance.

title: Vigil Mechanism & Whistleblower Channel
description: Establishment of a vigil mechanism for directors and employees to report genuine concerns or grievances with adequate safeguards against victimization.

sub_elements.element_text: Formal vigil mechanism or whistleblower policy for reporting grievances
Direct access to Audit Committee Chairperson and explicit protection safeguards against victimization

title: Grievance Redressal Committee Composition
description: Establishment of Grievance Redressal Committee for resolution of disputes arising out of individual grievances.

sub_elements.element_text: Constitution of Grievance Redressal Committee with equal representation of employer and workers
Adequate representation of women workers in the Grievance Redressal Committee proportional to total women workers
